verdict.rationale: USCIS's own pages say forms can be filed online through its secure online filing system, with fees paid online by card or ACH, using a free USCIS online account. It names specific online forms (N-400, I-90, I-130), and representatives can file on behalf of clients alongside Form G-28. Missing for 10: evidence that the full set of forms (including business or employer-relevant petitions) can be filed online rather than only 'certain' popular forms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of completing a filing end to end.
